messages:
Alexander: Quick sync — found an edge case in ratecard metering that causes double-counting for concurrent embedding+generation flows. We need owners & blockers for the pricing/packaging rollout tomorrow. Who can triage? /cc @Maria @Cheng

Maria: thx. can you paste repro? is it during burst/checkout path or per-request?

Alexander: repro: when a request includes embeddings + streaming tokens we currently emit two metering lines. example:
```
POST /v1/generate -> usage: tokens_generated=120
POST /v1/embeddings -> usage: embeddings=1
```
we're treating them as independent units instead of combined billing rule `ratecard.v2.combine_eg`

Cheng: I can take first look. pinging billing team. Cheng -> I'll open a PR to change the adapter to coalesce events. ETA 4h.

Jess: can you drop the PR link? also legal flagged contract constraint on plan 'pro' — can't change billing semantics without 24h notice to customers.

Cheng: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ratecard/pull/424 — it's small change, has unit tests, but needs metering infra approval from @Mohan and @sre-oncall

Mohan: reviewing now. main risk is downstream analytics pipeline relies on per-event keys — we need a migration path. propose a feature flag `ratecard.coalesce_v2` + 2-week ramp.

sre-oncall: rollout window tomorrow is 02:00-04:00 UTC; can do canary at 5% then 25% then 100% if flag present.

Maya: legal here — contract constraint: any change affecting quotas must be opt-in or with notice. If coalescing reduces customer charges we can do opt-out, but if it increases charges we need explicit notice. need product decision.

Alexander: product decision: we plan to preserve customer spend (coalescing only reduces duplicates), so proceed with opt-out notification + changelog. @Maya can you confirm wording?

Maya: yes, I will prepare a short notice — needs PM sign-off.

Luke-PM: assigning: Cheng (billing impl), Mohan (analytics/migration), SRE (rollout), Maya (legal notice). Next sync in this thread at 10:30 PST. If blockers, @me.

Cheng: starting work now, will post PR updates. :thumbsup: 

Mohan: added migration notes in PR, leaving comment for analytics owners.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for 2027-01-14T02:15Z (canary). See run-20270114-0215 for logs.

Alexander: thanks all. attaching short checklist:
- PR open + tests
- feature flag behind rollout
- legal notice drafted
- analytics migration plan
I'll update here as things land.
